The server rejects a client-supplied place override because browser place selection is presentation state, not backend authority. This trace does not invoke Project navigation, change a browser route, preserve browser-local focus or selection, or prove return to origin; those visible SP02 and UX-FLOW-07 behaviors remain design-owned.
